name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-quake-mcp
title: Iran Earthquakes
description: Unofficial read-only Iran earthquakes: latest, search, strongest, detail, stats (USGS, EMSC, IRSC).

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_QUAKE_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for reaching USGS/EMSC; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
